thread:
Maya Patel: Hey folks — I'm stuck at SFO, flight delayed and airline rebooked me for tomorrow morning. I'm the primary for the midnight->0800 shift tonight and I can't make it. Sorry for last-minute ask. Can someone cover primary? I can hand off notes now. :disappointed:

Samir Chen: I can take primary if no one else volunteers. I'm on EST but can be up for this one. Quick Q: any active long-running incidents I should know about?

Maya Patel: Thanks Samir. No active P0s right now. We had a small embedding backpressure earlier but it recovered. Main things: models/embedding-worker has a flaky OOM on long batches — runbook says toggle `BATCH_SIZE_CAP` to 64 as temp mitigation. Also customer-impact notes in the runbook. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/serving_midnight_checklist

David Nguyen: I can be secondary. Happy to shadow if Samir takes primary. I'm available to join bridge if pager fires.

Samir Chen: OK taking primary. @oncall-bot can you confirm shift swap and set me as primary for 1911-11-22 00:00->08:00 UTC?

oncall-bot: Shift swap request received from Maya Patel to Samir Chen. Please confirm with David Nguyen.

David Nguyen: Confirmed. Samir primary, David secondary. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Shift swap completed: Samir Chen is now primary for thread 1911112223. Maya Patel marked as unavailable.

incident-bot: ALERT -> model-serving-5xx-spike @channel
Details: 5xx rate increased to 2.7% over the last 2m (threshold 1%). Top source: model-pool-3. Pager severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-5xx-spike

Samir Chen: on it, joining logs now. Does anyone have recent deploys?

Maya Patel: No deploys from my side. Last deploy to model-pool-3 was 6h ago (canary).

Samir Chen: tailing logs ->

```
2026-03-15T00:04:12Z model-pool-3 worker-7 ERROR respond() 500 "OOM during attention matmul"
2026-03-15T00:04:13Z model-pool-3 worker-8 ERROR respond() 500 "KV cache miss and OOM"
```
Looks like OOM on longer contexts. I'm going to roll a mitigation: reduce `MAX_SEQ` in runtime config for pool-3 and drop batch cap.

David Nguyen: If you need me to open a quick rollback, I can kick a fallback to v1.12 which is heavier but more stable. Otherwise we can follow the runbook step 3 -> apply temporary quantization profile.

Samir Chen: Trying runbook step 2 first: set `BATCH_SIZE_CAP=32` and `MAX_SEQ=1024` on pool-3. Command:
`rdctl config set pool-3 BATCH_SIZE_CAP=32 MAX_SEQ=1024 --apply-now`

incident-bot: ACTION -> config change started by Samir Chen (rdctl). Job ID: cfg-8492. Notifying routing layer to drain old workers.

Samir Chen: Patch applied. Monitoring token error rate...

incident-bot: UPDATE -> model-serving-5xx-spike resolved. 5xx rate back to 0.4% over last 2m. Closing pager.

Samir Chen: Nice. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and follow up in incidents channel if anything recurs. David, can you file a short post-incident note with cause and next steps (longer term: bump GPU memory or split long-context inference path)?

David Nguyen: Yep, will file the PIR and add a list of remediation options (pool sizing, improved KV prefetching, alert tuning). Filing now: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1911112223-p1-5xx-spike

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone and sorry again for the scramble. Appreciate the quick handoff and the rapid mitigation. I'll sync with Samir offline to transfer a couple of runbook pointers for next time. :pray:
